description.mekasuitarcana.mana_conversi: Converts powered MekaSuit energy into the player's Iron's mana.
description.mekasuitarcana.amplification: Increases global spell power while the carrier is powered.
description.mekasuitarcana.focus: Increases one selected school's spell power while powered.
description.mekasuitarcana.cooldown_acce: Reduces spell cooldowns while powered, consuming energy over time.
description.mekasuitarcana.casting_stabi: Reduces cast time and removes the casting movement penalty while powered.
Limits the powered conversion rate and its energy draw.
module.mekasuitarcana.amplification_step: Scales this carrier's global spell-power contribution up to the server ceiling.
module.mekasuitarcana.focus_school.descr: Selects the one spell school affected by this carrier's Focus Units.
module.mekasuitarcana.focus_step.descrip: Scales this carrier's selected-school contribution up to the server ceiling.
module.mekasuitarcana.cooldown_step.desc: Scales cooldown reduction up to the server ceiling.
module.mekasuitarcana.casting_step.descr: Scales cast-time reduction up to the server ceiling.
